import sys

def solver():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [0, 0, 0]
    b = [0, 0, 0]
    a[0] = int(next(it))
    a[1] = int(next(it))
    a[2] = int(next(it))
    b[0] = int(next(it))
    b[1] = int(next(it))
    b[2] = int(next(it))

    maxWins = 0
    minNotWins = 0
    for i in range(3):
        maxWins += a[i] if a[i] < b[(i+1)%3] else b[(i+1)%3]
        lose = b[i] if b[i] < a[(i+1)%3] else a[(i+1)%3]
        draw = b[i] if b[i] < a[i] else a[i]
        minNotWins += b[i] if b[i] < (lose + draw) else (lose + draw)

    print(n - minNotWins, maxWins)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solver()
